module: Flowgraph node "Debug Line" (category repeat_instant, tags util/draw). Draws a debug line (debugDrawer:drawLine) from posA to posB every frame. Inputs: posA, posB (vec3, required), color (hidden, pink {0.91,0.05,0.48,0.5} by default).

work.desc: If posA and posB are set, draws the line with the given color.
